main.title: BSc Information and Communication Technology | KTH
quotes: This is a three year programme (180 ECTS credits) given in English. Graduates are awarded the degree of Bachelor of Science.
The programme is given by the School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (at KTH).
KTH Royal Institute of Technology SE-100 44 Stockholm Sweden

fees.title: Application and tuition fees for bachelor's programmes | KTH
quotes: The full programme tuition fee for non-EU/EEA/Swiss citizens studying the bachelor's programme in Information and Communication Technology is SEK 453,000.
Citizens of an EU/EEA country or Switzerland are not required to pay application and tuition fees.
The tuition fee is charged in advance for each semester and you pay by bank transfer.
